products.name: Waste Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive hazardous and nonhazardous waste disposal brokerage and management services, including arranging for transportation, treatment, and disposal at approved facilities. Services are provided to industrial, commercial, municipal, and governmental customers, requiring regulatory compliance and technical expertise.

products.name: Captive Landfill Management Services
products.description: Technical and operational management of captive disposal facilities, including daily operations, facilities management, and reporting for customers who own landfills that only accept their own waste. Requires on-site human labor and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Salt Water Injection Well Operations
products.description: Ownership and operation of salt water injection wells for the disposal of brine and other fluids, primarily serving the oil and gas industry. Involves regulated infrastructure, facility construction, and ongoing management.

products.name: Golf and Country Club Operations
products.description: Operation and management of multiple golf courses and country clubs, generating revenue from membership dues, greens fees, cart rentals, merchandise, and food and beverage sales. Requires physical facilities, grounds maintenance, and in-person services.

products.name: Resort and Hotel Services
products.description: Operation of a full-service resort and hotel, including room rentals, food and beverage sales, banquet and conference facilities, and access to resort amenities. Delivered through physical hospitality infrastructure and staff.

products.name: Athletic and Fitness Center Services
products.description: Operation of multipurpose athletic and fitness centers, offering indoor tennis, basketball, volleyball, pickleball courts, and fitness areas. Revenue is generated through membership fees and activity participation. Requires physical facilities and in-person staff.

products.name: Salon and Spa Services
products.description: Provision of salon and spa services, including appearance-improving nonsurgical aesthetic treatments, at clubhouses and resort facilities. Delivered by licensed professionals in dedicated physical spaces.

products.name: Dermatology Services
products.description: Provision of dermatology services by board licensed dermatologists at dedicated facilities. Requires medical professionals and regulated clinical infrastructure.

products.name: Residential Data Services
products.description: High-speed broadband internet access for residential customers, delivered over a fiber-to-the-premises or hybrid fiber-coaxial (HFC) network, with options for Gigabit and multi-Gigabit download speeds, advanced Wi-Fi, and supplemental services such as technology support and network security.

products.name: Business Data Services
products.description: Broadband internet and related connectivity solutions for business customers, including small, mid-market, enterprise, wholesale, and carrier clients, delivered over fiber and HFC networks with options for managed Wi-Fi, dedicated fiber, and symmetrical speeds up to 100 Gbps.

products.name: Residential Video Services
products.description: Television programming services for residential customers, including IPTV (Sparklight TV) and cloud-based DVR, delivered via internet protocol and accessible through supported streaming devices without the need for a set-top box.

products.name: Business Voice Services
products.description: Voice communication solutions for business customers, including hosted VoIP, unified communications, and traditional telephony, delivered over fiber and HFC networks with features such as multi-line options and advanced calling features.

products.name: Residential Voice Services
products.description: Digital and traditional voice (telephone) services for residential customers, primarily delivered as interconnected VoIP over the company's broadband network, with some traditional telephony offerings through subsidiaries.

products.name: Business Video Services
products.description: Television programming packages for business customers, ranging from basic to comprehensive selections, delivered over fiber and HFC networks and tailored for commercial environments.

products.name: Mobile Services (Pilot)
products.description: Mobile phone service offered on a pilot basis in select markets through a mobile virtual network enabler, intended to complement wired broadband offerings and provide added convenience and flexibility to customers.

products.name: Digital Programmatic Advertising Services
products.description: Provides precision customer targeting and advertising campaign execution for local, regional, and national advertisers using a proprietary digital programmatic advertising platform, including access to major ad exchanges, data management, and creative services. Delivered digitally via desktop, mobile, connected TV, email, paid search, and social media.

products.name: Owned and Operated Digital Media Advertising
products.description: Offers advertising opportunities across a portfolio of over 400 hyper-local websites, national music and entertainment websites, and mobile apps, leveraging original local content and first-party data to connect advertisers with targeted audiences. Delivered digitally through web and mobile platforms.

products.name: Subscription Digital Marketing Solutions
products.description: Provides small and medium-sized businesses with a subscription-based suite of digital marketing services, including website design, hosting, SEO, e-commerce, online reputation management, social media management, CRM, and marketing automation, delivered via a proprietary SaaS business management platform.

products.name: Broadcast Radio Advertising
products.description: Sells advertising spots on a network of 340 owned and operated local radio stations across 74 markets, offering local, regional, and national advertisers access to geographically targeted audiences through terrestrial radio broadcasts.

products.name: Live Events and Experiential Marketing
products.description: Produces and monetizes live events such as concerts, expositions, and festivals, generating revenue from ticket sales, sponsorships, concessions, and merchandise. Events are physically produced and managed by the company in local markets.

products.name: White-Labeled Digital Advertising Services
products.description: Provides digital programmatic advertising services to third parties on a contracted, white-label basis, allowing other organizations to offer Townsquare's advertising solutions under their own brand. Delivered digitally via the company's proprietary platform.

products.name: Wholesale Specialty Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Facilitates the placement of complex or hard-to-place property, casualty, professional lines, transportation, personal lines, and workers’ compensation insurance products for retail insurance brokers through relationships with insurance carriers. Delivered via in-person expertise and digital platforms, requiring regulatory licensing and deep industry knowledge.

products.name: Binding Authority Insurance Placement Services
products.description: Provides delegated authority to bind insurance coverage for a high volume of smaller-premium, well-defined risks, offering rapid turnaround and efficient processing for general liability, property, transportation, and other insurance lines. Delivered through in-house binding agreements with insurance carriers, requiring regulatory compliance and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Underwriting Management and Delegated Authority Programs (MGAs/MGUs)
products.description: Designs, underwrites, and administers specialty insurance and reinsurance products for specific risks and industry classes on behalf of insurance carriers, through managing general agents and underwriters (MGAs/MGUs) and national programs. Involves product development, underwriting, and policy administration, often with proprietary offerings and technology platforms.

products.name: Employee Benefits Insurance Solutions
products.description: Provides specialty employee benefits insurance products and services, including medical stop loss, group benefit captives, pharmacy, voluntary benefits, care management, and integrated health solutions, primarily for retail broker clients and their insureds. Delivered through broking, distribution, and underwriting, often leveraging acquisitions and specialized platforms.

products.name: Alternative Risk and Capital Management Solutions
products.description: Offers bespoke, multi-year risk solutions and alternative risk transfer products for corporate clients, including captives and other non-traditional insurance structures. Delivered through underwriting, structuring, and placement services, often requiring specialized expertise and collaboration with carriers and capital providers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a range of loans to business customers, including commercial real estate, hospitality, energy, and commercial and industrial loans. These loans are originated and serviced through in-person relationship banking at physical branches and require significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers loans to individuals for personal and household purposes, including residential real estate loans, personal lines of credit, auto loans, and other installment loans. These are delivered through branch-based and digital channels and require regulatory compliance and credit underwriting.

products.name: Deposit Banking Services
products.description: Provides deposit products to commercial and retail customers, including checking, savings, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and ATM access. These services are delivered through physical branches and digital platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and technology.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Provides mortgage banking services, including originating and servicing residential real estate loans for consumers. This involves both in-person and digital processes and is subject to significant regulatory oversight.

products.name: NurseMagic™ B2C App
products.description: A mobile application for individual nurses and caregivers that uses AI to reduce documentation time, simplify communication, and support daily workflow. Delivered digitally via app stores, it is designed for rapid adoption and ease of use, requiring no external system integration.

products.name: NurseMagic™ B2B Platform
products.description: An AI-powered enterprise software platform for healthcare organizations (home health, skilled nursing, hospice, assisted living) that streamlines workflow, enhances regulatory compliance, and improves operational efficiency. Delivered as a configurable, rapidly deployable digital solution for organizations of varying sizes.

products.name: Amesite Engage Platform
products.description: A digital platform for corporate and higher education learning, offering professional learning solutions powered by proprietary AI infrastructure. Delivered as a SaaS product, though currently not a focus for growth.

products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Provides a broad range of traditional banking services, including deposit accounts and lending products, to personal and commercial customers through physical branches, online banking, and ATMs. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure, physical locations, and digital platforms.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Offers wealth management solutions such as 401(k) plans, retirement planning, estate planning, estate settlements, and asset management, delivered through a trust department and specialized staff. Requires regulated financial expertise and in-person advisory services.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: Provides credit and mortgage life, accident and health insurance, as well as other insurance products to individuals and businesses, delivered through licensed agents and reinsurance subsidiaries. Requires regulatory compliance and licensed personnel.

products.name: Investment and Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers mutual funds, annuities, educational savings accounts, and other investment products through registered agents and broker-dealer arrangements. Delivered via licensed representatives and third-party agreements.

products.name: Pay-TV User Experience Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based, immersive, and personalized user experience solutions for Pay-TV operators, including interactive program guides, DVR, VOD integration, and content discovery, delivered via software platforms for set-top boxes and mobile devices.

products.name: IPTV and TV-as-a-Service Solutions
products.description: Managed, cloud-enabled, end-to-end streaming video solutions for operators, enabling rapid launch of branded Pay-TV services across devices without heavy infrastructure investment, including programming, DVR, recommendations, and dynamic ad insertion.

products.name: Entertainment Metadata Services
products.description: Comprehensive metadata libraries and services for linear and streaming television, sports, movies, and celebrities, licensed to customers for integration into their platforms to enhance content discovery and user experience.

products.name: Personalized Content Discovery and Voice Search Solutions
products.description: Advanced AI-driven content discovery, personalized recommendations, and natural language voice search technologies licensed to device manufacturers and service providers to enhance user engagement and content navigation.

products.name: TiVo DVR Subscriptions
products.description: Direct-to-consumer and third-party device subscriptions for TiVo DVR services, enabling recording, playback, and integration of digital and analog broadcast, cable, internet TV, and streaming content, primarily in the United States.

products.name: Home and Mobile Audio Solutions (DTS Audio Technologies)
products.description: Licensing of DTS audio codec and post-processing technologies for immersive, high-definition audio experiences in consumer electronics devices, including TVs, PCs, smartphones, tablets, soundbars, and home theater systems, delivered as software or integrated circuit solutions.

products.name: IMAX Enhanced Audio Solutions
products.description: Certification and licensing program for IMAX Enhanced immersive audio experiences, enabling consumer electronics manufacturers to deliver premium movie audio in partnership with IMAX and DTS.

products.name: HD Radio Technology
products.description: Licensing of HD Radio, a digital terrestrial broadcast system for AM/FM radio, to automotive manufacturers and radio stations, enabling high-quality, subscription-free in-vehicle radio experiences with advanced features and data services.

products.name: DTS AutoStage Automotive Infotainment Platform
products.description: Comprehensive automotive infotainment platform integrating DTS audio, TiVo video, metadata, and content discovery, licensed to automotive OEMs to deliver enhanced in-cabin entertainment, including audio, video, and gaming experiences.

products.name: TiVo OS for Smart TVs and Connected Cars
products.description: Linux-based operating system for Smart TVs and connected cars, providing a content-first user experience, personalized recommendations, and integration of streaming and linear TV, licensed to TV and automotive OEMs with monetization opportunities via advertising and service revenue shares.

products.name: Media Platform Advertising and Data Monetization Services
products.description: Advertising solutions and data licensing services leveraging the TiVo OS and other platforms, enabling advertisers and content producers to reach targeted audiences through ad placements, viewership data, and cross-platform campaigns.

products.name: Rare Earth Concentrate
products.description: Produced through mining and initial processing at the Mountain Pass facility, this concentrate contains a mix of rare earth elements and is sold to refiners and distributors for further separation and processing. Production involves physical mining, crushing, grinding, and flotation processes.

products.name: Separated Rare Earth Oxides and Products
products.description: Refined rare earth oxides and related products, including neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide, cerium, lanthanum, and mixed heavy rare earth products (SEG+), produced via advanced chemical separation and finishing processes at Mountain Pass. These are sold directly to end users and distributors, primarily for use in magnet manufacturing and other industrial applications.

products.name: Rare Earth Metals and Alloys
products.description: Manufactured at the Independence Facility, these include neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) metal and neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) alloy flake, produced through electrowinning and strip casting processes. These metals and alloys serve as precursor materials for magnet manufacturing and are sold to industrial customers.

products.name: NdFeB Permanent Magnets
products.description: Fully manufactured neodymium-iron-boron (NdFeB) permanent magnets produced at the Independence Facility (and future 10X Facility) using integrated processes including alloying, powder metallurgy, pressing, sintering, machining, and finishing. These magnets are sold to automotive, electronics, defense, and technology customers for use in electric motors, generators, and advanced devices.

products.name: Magnet Recycling Services and Recycled Rare Earth Products
products.description: Commercial-scale recycling of post-industrial and end-of-life rare earth magnets, recovering rare earth elements and producing recycled rare earth feedstock and magnets. This service is integrated at Mountain Pass and the Independence Facility, supporting closed-loop supply chains for customers such as Apple.

products.name: Heavy Rare Earth Elements (HREE) Products
products.description: Production and sale of heavy rare earth element products, such as terbium, dysprosium, and samarium oxides, enabled by the HREE Facility at Mountain Pass. These products are primarily used in high-performance magnets and advanced technology applications.

products.name: Property and Facilities Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of commercial real estate properties, including property management, facilities management, facilities services (such as janitorial, maintenance, landscaping, and office services), and project management. Delivered through in-person human labor and regulated infrastructure, often via multi-year contracts with recurring revenue.

products.name: Leasing Services
products.description: Representation of property owners and tenants in leasing transactions, including owner representation (leasing available space for owners) and tenant representation (identifying and negotiating leases, renewals, expansions, relocations, subleases, or terminations for tenants). Delivered through advisory and execution services by real estate professionals, typically compensated via commissions.

products.name: Capital Markets Services
products.description: Advisory and execution services for real estate purchase and sale transactions, including representing buyers and sellers, and arranging equity, debt, and structured financing for real estate acquisitions. Services are transactional and require financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Valuation and Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of real estate valuation and advisory services, including appraisal management, investment management, valuation advisory, portfolio advisory, diligence advisory, dispute analysis, litigation support, and financial reporting. Delivered by specialized professionals and often required for regulatory or financial reporting purposes.

products.name: Workplace and Sustainability Consulting
products.description: Consulting services focused on workplace strategy, workplace experience, and sustainability, including workplace consulting and sustainability services. Delivered through advisory engagements to help clients optimize their real estate for operational efficiency and environmental goals.

products.name: Biopharmaceutical Royalty Acquisition
products.description: Acquisition of royalty interests in approved and late-stage development biopharmaceutical therapies, entitling the company to payments based on top-line sales of marketed drugs. This is executed through purchasing existing royalties or creating synthetic royalties, and does not involve manufacturing or direct commercialization of therapies.

products.name: Milestone and Contractual Receipts Funding
products.description: Provision of capital to biopharmaceutical partners in exchange for rights to receive sales-based or regulatory milestone payments and other fixed contractual receipts, often as part of broader royalty transactions. These are structured financial agreements rather than product manufacturing or service delivery.

products.name: Development and Launch Capital Funding
products.description: Provision of funding to biopharmaceutical companies for product development, clinical trials, or commercial launch, in exchange for fixed long-term payments or enhanced royalty rights. This involves structured financial arrangements rather than operational drug development or commercialization.

products.name: Niobium Products
products.description: Produced through mining and processing at the Elk Creek Project, these products include niobium used in superalloys for high-performance aircraft, jet turbines, and high-strength, low-alloy steel for automotive, construction, and infrastructure applications. Production requires physical mining, mineral processing, and metallurgical operations.

products.name: Scandium Products
products.description: Produced via mining and processing at the Elk Creek Project, scandium is supplied for use in high-performance aluminum alloys and as a critical component in solid oxide fuel cells. Production involves extraction, concentration, and refining of scandium from ore.

products.name: Titanium Products
products.description: Titanium is mined and processed at the Elk Creek Project for use in superalloys, aerospace, defense, medical implants, and as pigments for paper, paint, and plastics. Production requires mining, mineral processing, and chemical refining.

products.name: Rare Earth Products
products.description: Potentially produced at the Elk Creek Project, rare earth elements (including magnetic rare earths like neodymium, praseodymium, terbium, and dysprosium) are supplied for use in defense systems, electronics, manufacturing, and high-technology sectors. Production involves mining, separation, and refining of rare earth elements from ore.

products.name: Cloud Networking Platform
products.description: A cloud-based platform (ExtremeCloud IQ and Extreme Platform ONE) providing end-to-end network management, visibility, and control for wired and wireless networks, delivered as SaaS and deployable in public, private, or on-premises environments. It leverages AI, analytics, and automation to streamline network operations and reduce complexity.

products.name: Automation, Analytics, and Security Applications
products.description: A suite of software applications providing network automation, analytics, access control, security, and management insights, available both on-premises and in the cloud. These applications extend management to multi-vendor devices and offer features like intrusion prevention, location services, and guest management.

products.name: Wireless LAN Access Points (APs) and Solutions
products.description: A portfolio of indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi access points (including Wi-Fi 7 and prior generations) and related wireless infrastructure, designed for high-density, large venues, and distributed environments. Includes wireless security and analytics features, and supports flexible deployment architectures via universal hardware.

products.name: Wired Switching Solutions
products.description: A range of Ethernet switches for edge, campus, and data center environments, supporting high-speed connectivity, Power-over-Ethernet, automation, and fabric-enabled networking. Includes both fixed and modular configurations, designed for scalability, reliability, and integration with centralized management software.

products.name: SD-WAN Solutions
products.description: Software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) solutions offered as an all-inclusive subscription, including hardware, cloud-based SD-WAN service, support, and security features. Enables optimized, secure connectivity for site-to-site and site-to-cloud environments, with integrated firewall and third-party security partnerships.

products.name: Cloud Native Platforms and Applications for Service Providers
products.description: Cloud-native network visibility and analytics platforms (e.g., Extreme 9000 series switches, 9920 intelligent network visibility platform) for service providers, enabling scalable traffic aggregation, packet processing, and advanced analytics in distributed and 5G environments.

products.name: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Security Solutions
products.description: A unified, cloud-managed security solution (ExtremeCloud Universal ZTNA) providing identity-based zero trust policy enforcement for network and application access, including IoT devices. Delivers automated security configuration, unified visualization, and reporting for secure hybrid work environments.

products.name: Customer Service and Support
products.description: A comprehensive suite of support, professional, and education services for end-users, resellers, and distributors, including technical assistance, proactive support, network consulting, deployment, and training. Delivered via global technical assistance centers and specialized teams.

products.name: Factory-Built Homes
products.description: Design and manufacture of factory-built homes, including manufactured homes and modular homes, constructed using an assembly-line process in controlled factory environments. Homes are customizable, range from entry-level to large custom models, and are distributed through independent and company-owned retailers, community operators, and developers.

products.name: Park Model RVs and Vacation Cabins
products.description: Production of park model recreational vehicles (RVs) and vacation cabins, built to American National Standards Institute standards, primarily used as vacation dwellings or for seasonal living. These are manufactured in factory facilities and distributed to planned communities, recreational parks, and resorts.

products.name: Factory-Built Commercial Structures
products.description: Manufacture of commercial modular structures such as apartment buildings, hotels, workforce housing, schools, and military barracks, engineered to purchaser specifications and built using the same assembly-line processes as residential homes.

products.name: Retail Home Sales
products.description: Operation of company-owned retail stores that sell factory-built homes directly to consumers, offering model homes, custom ordering, and inventory sales. Sales centers provide customer service and facilitate the home buying process.

products.name: Consumer Home Financing
products.description: Provision of retail home buyer financing through conforming and non-conforming mortgages and home-only loans for factory-built homes, including loan origination, servicing, and sale to investors. Financing is offered through a subsidiary authorized by FHA, VA, USDA, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and Ginnie Mae.

products.name: Homeowner Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Provision of property and casualty insurance products primarily for owners of manufactured homes, including direct policy writing and reinsurance, through a licensed insurance subsidiary operating in multiple states.

products.name: Commercial Financing for Distributors and Developers
products.description: Provision of commercial loans and wholesale floor plan financing to independent distributors, community owners, and developers for the purchase of factory-built homes, supporting product distribution and inventory financing.

products.name: Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) and Strategic Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory services for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, spin-offs, joint ventures, fairness opinions, and shareholder advisory, delivered by experienced professionals through in-person and virtual engagements, leveraging deep industry knowledge and global reach.

products.name: Capital Markets Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory and execution services for public and private equity and debt transactions, including structuring, placement, underwriting, and bookrunning, requiring financial expertise and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Recapitalization and Restructuring Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory services for clients in financial distress, including capital structure optimization, liability management, and restructuring, delivered by specialized professionals with access to creditor and capital networks.

products.name: Private Capital Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory and execution services for private capital fundraising and secondary market transactions for financial sponsors and institutional investors, including continuation funds, direct secondaries, strip sales, tender offers, and co-investment capital raising, leveraging sector expertise and global investor reach.

products.name: Special Committee and Board Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory services to special committees and boards of directors on evaluating strategic alternatives, governance, and negotiating proposals, requiring in-depth transaction experience and confidentiality.

products.name: Shareholder Advisory Services
products.description: Advisory services to corporate boards on shareholder engagement, activism defense, and preparedness, delivered by experienced teams with expertise in public company governance and capital markets.

products.name: Other Financial Advisory Services
products.description: Specialized advisory services including risk exposure analysis, expert witness testimony, and negotiation support for private clients and governments, delivered by professionals with deep financial and legal expertise.

products.name: Data Center Hosting and Colocation Services
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of purpose-built data center facilities for energy-intensive technology applications, including AI, high-performance computing (HPC), and ASIC compute. Delivered through physical infrastructure, these services are provided via long-term hosting, leasing, or colocation agreements to third-party customers.

products.name: AI Cloud Infrastructure Services
products.description: Provision of cloud infrastructure platforms purpose-built for AI workloads, offering bare-metal performance and full-stack orchestration for training and deploying production-scale AI models. Delivered digitally via cloud platforms using specialized hardware such as NVIDIA GPUs.

products.name: Traditional Cloud and Managed IT Services
products.description: Provision of enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, including public and private cloud deployments, managed backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and high-capacity storage solutions. Delivered digitally and through managed services from data centers.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining and ASIC Compute Services
products.description: Operation of industrial-scale ASIC compute infrastructure to mine Bitcoin and earn mining rewards, primarily through owned and operated data centers. Delivered via physical deployment of specialized ASIC hardware and participation in mining pools.

products.name: Power Infrastructure Development and Management Services
products.description: Origination, development, and management of powered land and energy infrastructure assets, including interconnects, substations, and generation assets, to enable large-scale, energy-intensive infrastructure deployment. Delivered through physical infrastructure projects and managed services arrangements, sometimes for third parties.

products.name: Equipment Sales and Repairs
products.description: Sale and repair of equipment related to power, digital infrastructure, and compute operations. Delivered as ancillary services to external customers.

products.name: Workplace Furnishings
products.description: A broad range of commercial office furniture and related products, including panel-based and freestanding furniture systems, seating, benching, tables, architectural products, storage, ancillary products, hospitality products, and social collaborative items. These are designed, manufactured, and marketed under multiple brands and delivered through independent and company-owned dealers, distributors, and direct sales to end-users and government entities.

products.name: Residential Hearth Products
products.description: A full array of prefabricated fireplaces, inserts, stoves, facings, outdoor fire pits and fire tables, and accessories, fueled by gas, wood, electric, or pellets. These products are manufactured and marketed primarily for residential use and distributed through independent dealers, distributors, and company-owned installing distribution and retail outlets.

products.name: Central Processing Algorithm Solutions for Internet Advertisement
products.description: Custom software and algorithmic solutions that optimize digital advertising content, match internet traffic, and deliver targeted advertisements for enterprise customers. Delivered as a service integrating proprietary algorithms with customer data and ad placement infrastructure, requiring advanced software development and data processing capabilities.

products.name: Central Processing Algorithm Solutions for Gaming Industry
products.description: Cloud-based platform and algorithmic services for game developers and distributors, including game distribution, software and hardware optimization, lightweight data processing, and gamer-targeted marketing. Delivered via a proprietary cloud-hosted platform integrating both software and hardware acceleration, requiring ongoing R&D and infrastructure.

products.name: Intelligent Chip Optimization Solutions
products.description: Integrated hardware and software solutions for electronics manufacturers and infrastructure providers, optimizing intelligent chip performance through bespoke central processing algorithms, including hardware (CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC) and software co-design, delivered as both technical services and direct product sales.

products.name: Government Cloud Central Processing Algorithm Services
products.description: Algorithmic and cloud-based solutions for government entities to manage, analyze, and share large-scale data, supporting smart city initiatives and digital transformation. Delivered as a platform integrating infrastructure, software, and data management, requiring regulated infrastructure and advanced software.

products.name: Manufacturing Industry Central Processing Algorithm Services
products.description: Algorithmic solutions and platforms for manufacturing enterprises to enable intelligent control, operation optimization, and production organization through data analysis and industrial IoT integration. Delivered as software and hardware integration, supporting digitalization and networked manufacturing.

products.name: Financial Technology Central Processing Algorithm Services
products.description: Custom algorithmic and data processing solutions for financial institutions, enabling high-concurrency, real-time trading, big data analysis, and visualization. Delivered as software and cloud-based services, supporting digital finance transformation and requiring secure, scalable infrastructure.

products.name: Medical Cloud Central Processing Algorithm Services
products.description: Cloud-based algorithmic solutions for healthcare providers, supporting intelligent healthcare applications such as disease prediction, medical image analysis, and remote consultation. Delivered as a platform integrating big data, AI, and cloud infrastructure, requiring compliance with healthcare data standards.

products.name: Intelligent Transportation Central Processing Algorithm Services
products.description: Algorithmic and cloud solutions for transportation industry players, enabling real-time traffic management, prediction, and control through terminal-edge-cloud architecture. Delivered as integrated software and hardware platforms for smart transportation systems.

products.name: 3D PaaS Central Processing Algorithm Cloud Services
products.description: Cloud-based platform providing 3D data processing, scenario intelligence, and visualization services for internet industry applications, including VR, AR, games, and e-commerce. Delivered as a hybrid cloud service with proprietary 3D acceleration algorithms and interactive streaming.

products.name: Central Processing Algorithm Cloud Service for Enterprise (SAAS) Marketing
products.description: SaaS platform leveraging central processing algorithms for enterprise marketing, offering 3D product display, VR tours, live broadcast, data optimization, and user matching. Delivered as a cloud-based service with annual fees, technology licensing, and streaming platform integration.

products.name: M&A and Strategic Advisory
products.description: Advisory services for mergers, acquisitions, and other strategic business decisions, delivered by experienced professionals through in-person and remote consultations, leveraging deep industry and technical expertise.

products.name: Financing and Capital Solutions Advisory
products.description: Comprehensive advice on capital structure, financing solutions, and capital markets transactions, including restructuring and liability management, provided by financial experts through tailored, client-specific engagements.

products.name: Shareholder Engagement Advisory
products.description: Advisory services focused on shareholder engagement strategies, helping clients navigate complex shareholder relations and activism, delivered through expert consultation and strategic planning.

products.name: Private Funds Advisory
products.description: Advisory services for private funds, including fundraising and structuring, provided to institutional and private clients through specialized financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Private Capital Placement
products.description: Assistance with the placement of private capital, connecting clients with private investors and structuring transactions, delivered by financial professionals with access to a broad investor network.

products.name: Specialized Underwriting and Research Services (Energy and Related Industries)
products.description: Underwriting and equity research services primarily for the energy and related sectors, involving regulated financial processes and in-depth industry analysis, delivered by sector specialists.

products.name: Radiopharmaceutical Oncology Diagnostics
products.description: F-18-labeled PET imaging agents, primarily PYLARIFY, used for PET/CT imaging of PSMA-positive lesions in prostate cancer. Manufactured at specialized PMFs with cyclotrons and distributed rapidly due to short half-life of F-18.

products.name: Ultrasound Enhancing Agents
products.description: Injectable microbubble agents (DEFINITY) used to enhance echocardiography imaging. Manufactured as sterile liquid, activated with specialized devices (VIALMIX), and distributed to hospitals and imaging centers.

products.name: Neuroimaging PET Diagnostics
products.description: F-18-labeled PET imaging agents (Neuraceq) for detection of beta-amyloid plaques in the brain, aiding diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive impairment. Manufactured at PMFs with cyclotrons and distributed rapidly.

products.name: Digital Imaging Analysis Software
products.description: AI-enabled medical device software (aBSI, aPROMISE/PYLARIFY AI) for automated analysis and quantification of imaging data, including bone scan disease burden and PSMA PET/CT images. Delivered as cloud-based or workstation software, FDA-cleared and CE Marked.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) Services
products.description: End-to-end cGMP manufacturing services for radiopharmaceuticals, including process development, clinical and commercial batch production, quality testing, and logistics. Provided through a dedicated facility acquired via Evergreen merger.

products.name: Out-Licensed Radiopharmaceuticals and Royalties
products.description: Licensing of proprietary radiopharmaceuticals (e.g., flurpiridaz/Flyrcado, PYLARIFY, Neuraceq, RELISTOR) to third parties for commercialization in select markets, generating milestone and royalty revenue.

products.name: Biomarker Solutions and Research Tools
products.description: Provision of imaging biomarker solutions and investigational radiodiagnostics (e.g., MK-6240, NAV-4694, LNTH-2620) for use as research tools in clinical trials by pharmaceutical companies and academic institutions. Revenue includes research fees and milestones.

products.name: Variable Annuities
products.description: Tax-deferred investment products offering customers participation in market returns through a broad selection of funds, with optional guaranteed benefits such as lifetime income, withdrawal, and death benefits. These are manufactured and administered by the company and distributed through financial intermediaries.

products.name: Registered Index-Linked Annuities (RILAs)
products.description: Annuity products that provide market index-linked investment options with customizable crediting strategies, term lengths, and levels of downside protection (floors or buffers), offering partial or full protection against market losses. Delivered through commission and advisory-based suites.

products.name: Fixed and Fixed Index Annuities
products.description: Insurance products offering guaranteed minimum crediting rates, with fixed annuities providing set interest rates and fixed index annuities allowing allocation to fixed or indexed accounts tied to market indices, sometimes with optional lifetime income benefits. These are manufactured and distributed nationwide.

products.name: Payout Annuities
products.description: Products that convert a lump sum or accumulated value into a stream of periodic income payments, typically for life or a set period, providing guaranteed income to retirees. These are manufactured and administered by the company.

products.name: Lifetime Income Solutions for Defined Contribution Plans
products.description: Annuity-based solutions integrated into defined contribution retirement plans, offering plan participants guaranteed income options similar to variable annuity features, delivered through partnerships with retirement plan platforms.

products.name: Institutional Investment Products (Guaranteed Investment Contracts and Funding Agreements)
products.description: Investment contracts and funding agreements issued to institutional and corporate investors, guaranteeing payment of principal and interest at fixed or floating rates over set terms, often used for funding or collateralization purposes. These are issued opportunistically based on market conditions.

products.name: Closed Life Insurance Blocks
products.description: In-force blocks of traditional and interest-sensitive life insurance products (whole life, universal life, variable universal life, term life) acquired through past sales or acquisitions, now managed but not actively sold to new customers.

products.name: Investment Management Services for Third Parties
products.description: Asset management services provided to external institutional clients, including management of public fixed income, private equity, private debt, and commercial real estate portfolios, delivered through the PPM America subsidiary.

products.name: Hotel Ownership and Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of upscale and upper upscale full-service hotel properties, primarily branded under Hilton, Hyatt, Marriott, and Intercontinental Hotel Group, with properties operated by third-party management companies. This involves physical real estate acquisition, capital investment, and asset management.

products.name: Mezzanine and First Mortgage Financing for Hospitality Assets
products.description: Provision of mezzanine and first mortgage financing to hotel owners and operators, either through origination or acquisition of debt instruments, as part of hospitality-related investment transactions. This is a financial capital product, not involving direct hotel operations.

products.name: Sale-Leaseback Transactions for Hotel Properties
products.description: Engagement in sale-leaseback transactions involving hotel properties, allowing other parties to operate hotels while Ashford retains ownership and receives lease income. This is a real estate financial structure product.

products.name: Specialty Metals Flat Products
products.description: Processed and distributed aluminum and stainless steel flat-rolled sheet, coil, plate, bar, angles, rounds, tube, and pipe, as well as tin mill products and fabricated parts. Products are manufactured and processed using specialized equipment and value-added services such as cutting, slitting, and forming.

products.name: Carbon Flat Products
products.description: Processed and distributed carbon and coated flat-rolled sheet, coil, and plate products, including fabricated parts. Also includes self-dumping metal hoppers, hydraulic dump inserts, and metal-intensive branded products. Products are manufactured and processed with value-added services such as cutting, slitting, and forming.

products.name: Tubular and Pipe Products
products.description: Distribution and fabrication of metal tubing, pipe, bar, valves, and fittings, including contract manufacturing for industrial markets. Products are processed using tube laser cutting, bending, welding, and other fabrication services.

products.name: Metal-Intensive End-Use Products
products.description: Manufacture and sale of finished metal products such as service station canopies, deck clips, long gutters, trim, boat docks, solar canopy and ground racking components, venting, micro air and clean air products, stainless steel bollards, and water treatment systems. These are manufactured using in-house fabrication and assembly capabilities.

products.name: Toll Processing Services
products.description: Processing of customer-owned metals, including cutting, slitting, shearing, forming, machining, and finishing, using specialized equipment. Services are provided to external customers who supply their own raw materials.

products.name: Integrated Benefits Administration
products.description: Comprehensive administration of employee benefits, including health, wealth, and leave solutions, delivered through a cloud-based platform and supported by customer care centers. Services are provided digitally and via omnichannel engagement, leveraging proprietary technology and data analytics.

products.name: Healthcare Navigation Services
products.description: Guidance and support for employees and their families to navigate healthcare options, claims, and providers, delivered through digital tools and customer support, utilizing data analytics and AI for personalized recommendations.

products.name: Financial Wellbeing Solutions
products.description: Services and tools to support employees' financial health, including retirement planning and financial education, delivered via digital platforms and integrated with benefits administration.

products.name: Leave of Absence Management
products.description: Administration and management of employee leave programs, including compliance and tracking, provided through digital platforms and customer support.

products.name: Retiree Healthcare Solutions
products.description: Support and administration of healthcare benefits for retirees, integrated into the overall benefits platform and delivered digitally and through customer care.

products.name: Alight Worklife Platform
products.description: A proprietary, cloud-based employee engagement platform that integrates benefits administration, healthcare navigation, and financial wellbeing services, accessible via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Warehousing and Order Fulfillment Services
products.description: Comprehensive storage, inventory management, picking, packing, labeling, kitting, repackaging, order assembly, load consolidation, and value-added services (such as returns management and specialized packaging) provided through a network of automated warehouses across the U.S. for e-commerce merchants. Services are delivered using physical infrastructure, automation, and in-person labor, with technology integration for real-time tracking and management.

products.name: International Ocean Freight Services
products.description: Arrangement and management of overseas transportation of goods to the U.S. via ocean freight, including coordination with global carriers, customs clearance, and delivery to U.S. warehouses. This service is provided through partnerships with third-party shipping lines and involves regulated logistics infrastructure and compliance expertise.

products.name: Customs Brokerage Services
products.description: Licensed customs brokerage services assisting customers with regulatory compliance, documentation, product classification, electronic submission, and payment of duties and tariffs for goods entering the U.S. Delivered by in-house licensed brokers and includes consulting, training, and compliance program development.

products.name: Port Trucking and Drayage Services
products.description: Short-distance transportation of shipping containers from U.S. ports to warehouses or distribution centers, using a fleet of trucks equipped with GPS tracking. This service ensures efficient movement of goods from ports to storage or fulfillment facilities and is a critical link in the supply chain.

products.name: Facility Rental Services
products.description: Short- or long-term rental of warehouse or facility space to customers, primarily domestic, who require additional storage or production space without investing in their own infrastructure. Delivered through the company’s leased warehouse network.

products.name: Architectural Paint and Coatings
products.description: Manufactured and sold through company-operated specialty paint stores and third-party retailers, these products include interior and exterior paints and coatings for residential, commercial, and industrial use. Production involves physical manufacturing and distribution via retail and direct sales channels.

products.name: Protective and Marine Coatings
products.description: Specialized coatings designed for protection in harsh environments, including marine and industrial applications, produced in manufacturing facilities and distributed through company stores and branches worldwide.

products.name: Industrial Coatings and OEM Finishes
products.description: Coatings and finishes for wood, metal, plastic, and other industrial applications, including OEM product finishes, manufactured and distributed globally through direct sales and company branches.

products.name: Automotive Refinish Coatings
products.description: Coatings specifically formulated for automotive refinishing, produced in dedicated facilities and distributed through company-operated branches and direct sales staff worldwide.

products.name: Coil and Packaging Coatings
products.description: Coatings for coil (metal) and packaging applications, manufactured in specialized facilities and sold to industrial customers globally through direct and distributor channels.

products.name: Performance-Based Resins and Colorants
products.description: Manufactured resins and colorants used in coatings and other applications, sold to industrial customers and third-party distributors worldwide.

products.name: Stains, Varnishes, and Wood Care Products
products.description: Manufactured stains, varnishes, wood finishes, and wood preservatives for residential and commercial use, distributed through retailers and company stores.

products.name: Aerosols, Caulks, and Adhesives
products.description: Manufactured and distributed aerosol paints, caulks, and adhesives for consumer and professional use, sold through retail and distribution channels.

products.name: Applicators and Sundry Products
products.description: Manufactured and purchased applicators (such as brushes and rollers) and sundry items, sold alongside paint and coatings through company stores and third-party retailers.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing Services
products.description: Leasing of non-retail properties owned and managed by the company, including office and research facilities, to external customers.

products.name: Scheduled Passenger Air Transportation
products.description: Southwest provides scheduled air transportation services for passengers within the United States and to near-international destinations using its fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft. This service is delivered through a point-to-point route network, offering frequent, conveniently timed flights, and a variety of fare bundles with optional assigned and extra legroom seating.

products.name: Vacation Packages (Getaways by Southwest)
products.description: Southwest offers customizable vacation packages that bundle air travel with hotel accommodations and excursions, delivered through its in-house Getaways by Southwest product. These packages are sold directly to customers and include customer-friendly policies such as flexible cancellations and no change fees.

products.name: Ancillary Services (Priority Boarding, Pet and Unaccompanied Minor Transportation)
products.description: Southwest sells ancillary services such as Priority Boarding (allowing customers to upgrade their boarding group), transportation of small pets in the cabin, and unaccompanied minor services. These are sold as add-ons to the core air transportation product and require in-person or operational support at airports.

products.name: Loyalty Program (Rapid Rewards)
products.description: Southwest operates the Rapid Rewards loyalty program, allowing members to earn and redeem points for flights and other rewards. The program is delivered digitally and includes partnerships with hotels, car rental agencies, and co-branded credit and debit cards, generating revenue from both customer engagement and partner relationships.

products.name: Corporate and Group Travel Services (Southwest Business)
products.description: Southwest provides specialized booking, management, and reporting tools for corporate and group travel customers, including access through global distribution systems, SWABIZ, and dedicated products for meetings and conventions. These services are delivered via digital platforms and supported by dedicated teams.

products.name: Global Airline Partnerships and Interline Ticketing
products.description: Southwest partners with international airlines to offer customers access to additional global destinations through interline agreements. These partnerships enable ticketing and itinerary combinations with partner carriers, expanding Southwest’s network reach beyond its own operated flights.

products.name: RxSight Light Adjustable Lens System (RxSight system)
products.description: A proprietary medical device system for premium cataract surgery, consisting of the Light Adjustable Lens (LAL) and the Light Delivery Device (LDD), enabling post-surgical customization of intraocular lens power via in-office UV light treatments. The LAL is manufactured from a proprietary silicone-based photosensitive material, and the LDD is a specialized UV light projector device installed in ophthalmology practices.

products.name: Void-Fill Protective Packaging Systems
products.description: Paper-based systems that convert paper into void-fill material to fill empty spaces in packages, protecting objects during shipping. Delivered via proprietary machines (FillPak units) and consumable paper products, manufactured from recycled or virgin fiber, and distributed globally.

products.name: Cushioning Protective Packaging Systems
products.description: Paper-based systems that convert paper into cushioning pads by crimping to trap air, protecting objects from shocks and vibrations during shipping. Delivered via proprietary machines (PadPak units) and consumable paper products, manufactured from recycled or virgin fiber.

products.name: Wrapping Protective Packaging Systems
products.description: Paper-based systems that create pads or mesh to wrap and protect fragile items from shock and surface damage during shipping. Delivered via proprietary machines (WrapPak and Geami units) and consumable paper products, including specialized cold chain solutions.

products.name: Cold Chain Packaging Solutions
products.description: Sustainable, fiber-based packaging products such as recyclable liners and plant-based cool packs designed to keep perishable goods cold during transit. Delivered as part of the Wrapping product line, including products like RecyCold® climaliner Plus™.

products.name: Automation and End-of-Line Packaging Systems
products.description: Automated systems and robotics for end-of-line packaging, including automated dunnage insertion, box-sizing, case erecting, and machine vision solutions. Delivered through design, manufacturing, installation, and servicing of automation equipment, as well as digital tools and data subscriptions.

products.name: Machine Vision Solutions for Packaging
products.description: Software and hardware solutions using computer vision and AI to inspect, monitor, and optimize packaging processes, including quality checks, compliance, and operational insights. Delivered as part of automation systems or as standalone modules.

products.name: Custom Printed Packaging Solutions
products.description: In-line printing solutions that allow customers to print full-color customized designs on packaging materials, supporting branding and operational efficiency. Delivered as an add-on to packaging systems (e.g., Print’it!™).

products.name: Sustainable Paper Mailers
products.description: Environmentally friendly, fully curbside recyclable mailers utilizing honeycomb paper insulation as alternatives to traditional plastic mailers. Delivered as consumable packaging products (e.g., naturemailer™).

products.name: Asset Servicing
products.description: Comprehensive asset servicing solutions for institutional investors, including custody, fund administration, investment operations outsourcing, risk and analytical services, securities lending, foreign exchange, treasury management, brokerage, transition management, and cash management. Delivered through a global network and requires regulated infrastructure, technology, and specialized human expertise.

products.name: Wealth Management
products.description: Integrated wealth management services for high-net-worth individuals, families, and family offices, including trust and fiduciary services, investment management, custody, philanthropic services, financial consulting, estate administration, family business consulting, financial education, brokerage, and private and business banking. Delivered via multidisciplinary teams and a network of offices, combining regulated financial products and personalized advisory.

products.name: Asset Management
products.description: Global asset management solutions for institutional and wealth clients, including active and passive equity and fixed income, cash management, multi-asset and alternative investments (such as private equity and hedge funds of funds), and multi-manager advisory services. Delivered through managed accounts, collective funds, ETFs, and private investment funds, requiring financial capital, investment expertise, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: A range of commercial and private banking services, including deposit accounts, cash management, lending, and treasury services, provided to institutional and wealth clients. Requires regulated banking infrastructure and capital, and is delivered through physical and digital channels.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Brokerage services for institutional and wealth clients, including securities trading, execution, and related advisory, delivered through registered broker-dealer subsidiaries and requiring regulatory compliance and trading infrastructure.

products.name: Securities Lending
products.description: Securities lending services for institutional clients, enabling them to lend securities to borrowers in exchange for fees, managed through regulated platforms and requiring risk management and operational expertise.

products.name: Foreign Exchange Services
products.description: Foreign exchange trading and currency management services for institutional and wealth clients, supporting cross-border transactions and investment operations. Delivered through regulated trading desks and technology platforms.

products.name: Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Trust and fiduciary services for individuals, families, and institutions, including estate administration, guardianship, and philanthropic trust management. Requires specialized legal, regulatory, and administrative expertise.
